title: Spicy Chicken Ramen Bowl
description: A hearty ramen bowl with chicken, soft-boiled eggs, and a spicy broth.
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions.
Heat chicken broth in a separate pot and stir in soy sauce, sesame oil, and chili paste.
Add shredded chicken to the broth and simmer for 5 minutes.
Divide cooked noodles between serving bowls.
Pour the hot broth and chicken over the noodles.
Top with soft-boiled eggs, green onions, and nori.
